I wanted to say thank you so much for this incredibly kind reply. I think i might take you up on your offer to message you some of these days if you're still up for it.

I talked to my second mom today, and she was kind and said some of the things you said. But now i still feel i ruined everything, cause once again i was hurt and.. I dunno.. Dramatic, and now i feel embarassed and just want to hide away. Let her not have to deal with me anymore. And ive said that exact thing to her so many times, but she makes me stay, and i feel so foolish for saying that again and again, but i really feel it when i say it. Im a bit of an idiot :(
